origin: User attachment supplied while correcting the bridge demo

alpha.policy: Original alpha bytes retained; no matte removal, recoloring or image regeneration.

use: Both engineering variants use this complete authored illustration as their shared rock and terrace core. Their independent bridge and optional crumble plate are separate objects.

display.interfaceCollars: Additional 64-unit collars outside the original illustration; only 8-unit edge blending and deep-bedrock bottom blending.

geometry.floor: Explicit foot path along the drawn soil tops; foreground rubble is not converted into walking steps.
geometry.internalTerrain: Original terraces retained; no generic U-shaped cut or procedurally painted road replaces the core.
